purpose: Firebase Crashlytics key-file injection contract (no secret values).

android.gradleBehavior: Apply com.google.gms.google-services and com.google.firebase.crashlytics only when google-services.json exists.
android.ciInjection: Write google-services.json from CI secret before android assemble/release jobs that need Crashlytics.

ios.ciInjection: Write GoogleService-Info.plist from CI secret before archive/release jobs that need Crashlytics.
ios.xcodeNote: File must be a member of the Runner target when present; absence is tolerated for debug/test builds.

runtime.missingConfigBehavior: initializeMobileCrashReporting soft-fails to NoopCrashlyticsGateway; app continues.
